workload.note: Rushing: 22 carries, 73 yards, 1 rushing TD (separate from the receiving line above).

scheme.note: Macdonald has been HC since Jan 31, 2024 — not a 2026 change. Fleury listed as OC on team site; whether this is a new 2026 hire could not be confirmed in this pass.

competition.name: Jadarian Price
competition.note: Born Oct 9, 2003; Seahawks 1st-round rookie (32nd overall) out of Notre Dame. A July 27, 2026 report says Price and Holani have 'split first-team reps during the early days of training camp,' with coaches emphasizing Price's development as a pass-catcher. Holani could be the Week 1 3rd-down favorite unless Price improves rapidly.

competition.name: Zach Charbonnet
competition.note: Born Jan 8, 2001. Suffered a torn ACL Jan 17-19, 2026 in the divisional-round playoff win over SF; surgery Feb 2026. Placed on PUP list before camp (reported July 22-24, 2026). HC Macdonald: 'not going to miss the whole year,' but a Week 1 return looks unlikely; PUP players can begin practicing after Week 2 of the regular season under 2026 rules.

notes: Kenneth Walker III left Seattle in 2026 free agency, reportedly signing with the Chiefs, removing him from the RB competition entirely.

An earlier April 24, 2026 depth-chart snapshot listed Price as outright starter and Holani as 'immediate backup/workload share' — the more recent July 27, 2026 report describing an actual reps split during camp is treated as the current status per the later-report-wins rule.

camp.quote: Holani and rookie first-round pick Jadarian Price have split first-team reps during the early days of training camp.
Once Charbonnet is cleared to return, Seattle could end up deploying all three to some extent.
